does: A writing skill that rewrites model text so a person can read it once and remember it.

children.does: What the skill does with an em dash. warn points out each one and leaves it, rewrite turns each into an ordinary sentence, and allow says nothing.
Puts the main point in the first sentence and cuts the warm-up.
Orders the text so each paragraph follows from the one before.
Keeps one idea per sentence and breaks paragraphs where the idea changes.
Keeps one restatement of the main point and cuts the other repeats.
Puts what matters first and makes the text shorter.
Drops definitions and hedges the reader does not need.
Cuts the phrases and patterns that make text read as machine-written.
Swaps vague claims for one specific example or number.
Asks for short sentences and common words that a reader of English as a second language can follow.
Makes diagrams readable for a person, with a rendered picture, one direction and plain labels.
Runs a short list of checks before the text goes back.
